hardinessZones.source: zonkartan.se (Svensk Trädgård) address lookup, 2026-10-16. Covers woody plants only (trees, bushes, fruit), not vegetables.

lastSpringFrost.source: SMHI open data, Stockholm-Bromma station 97200: daily min air temperature, 1991–2020, frost = min below 0 °C. Computed 2026-10-30. City-centre station Observatoriekullen is 2–3 weeks milder.

firstAutumnFrost.source: SMHI open data, Stockholm-Bromma station 97200: daily min air temperature, 1991–2020, frost = min below 0 °C. Computed 2026-10-30. City-centre station Observatoriekullen is 2–3 weeks milder.

vegetationPeriod.source: SMHI Vegetationsperiod map, 1991–2020 (days with mean temperature above +5°C).

notes: Deep lying snow ~2 months — insulating, but the ground freezes solid.
Winter harvest is from stores (sand boxes, cured onions/garlic), not the ground.
Plant garlic & overwintering onions early (Sept–Oct) to root before freeze.
